description: This Java class defines the ConceptAttribute, a persistent entity representing attributes associated with medical concepts in the OpenMRS system. It extends a base attribute class and maintains the mapping between concept attributes and their types, including getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: ConceptAttribute
classes.description: A persistent entity class representing additional attributes for concepts within OpenMRS, with Hibernate Envers auditing enabled. It extends a generic attribute class to associate specific attribute types with concept objects, providing standard getter and setter methods.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the Concept object that owns this attribute.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Associates this attribute with a specific Concept object.

methods.name: getConceptAttributeId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier for this ConceptAttribute.

methods.name: setConceptAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for this ConceptAttribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides the base method to get the ID, returning the concept attribute's ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides the base method to set the ID of this ConceptAttribute.
